items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewer mentions Richard M. Jones taking the interviewer to the Dreamland, but the interviewee does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Richard M. Jones.

ctx.x: It was that entertainment. But a flow show and dancing.

I did once go to the Dreamland. Richard M. Jones took me over to the Dreamland. I remember they had a big glass or mirror or something in the floor there too. She worked there. Did you work there too?
Yes, I worked there too. Well, and Willie Umfrey. Do you know him?
